vocabulary.meaning: to stop sleeping and open your eyes in the morning
to clean your teeth with a brush and toothpaste

translation.Japanese: 彼は朝ごはんの後で歯をみがきます。

vocabulary.meaning: to travel from home to school

meaning_translation.Japanese: 家から学校へ行くこと

translation.Hindi: मैं बस से स्कूल जाता हूँ।

vocabulary.meaning: to learn by reading or listening

meaning_translation.Japanese: 読んだり聞いたりして学ぶこと

vocabulary.meaning: to eat food in the middle of the day

vocabulary.meaning: to complete school work at home

examples.sentence: I do my homework in the evening.

translation.Hindi: मैं शाम को गृहकार्य करता हूँ।

vocabulary.meaning: to lie down and sleep at night

examples.sentence: Children go to bed at 9 o'clock.

translation.Japanese: 子どもたちは9時に寝ます。

grammar_tips.title: Using the Present Simple for Routine
grammar_tips.explanation: We use the present simple to talk about daily routines. Example: 'I get up at 6 o’clock.'

explanation_translation.Hindi: रोज़मर्रा की आदतों के लिए Present Simple Tense का प्रयोग करें। जैसे: 'I get up at 6 o’clock.'
explanation_translation.Japanese: 日常の習慣を言うときは現在形を使います。例: 'I get up at 6 o’clock.'

grammar_tips.title: Talking about times with 'at'
grammar_tips.explanation: Use 'at' to say when you do something. Example: 'I go to bed at 10 o’clock.'

explanation_translation.Hindi: 'at' का उपयोग समय के साथ करें। जैसे: 'I go to bed at 10 o’clock.'
explanation_translation.Japanese: 時間を言うときは 'at' を使います。例: 'I go to bed at 10 o’clock.'
